primary.title: Want relief from double taxation on foreign income under DTAA? Know how to apply for residency certificate using Form 42
primary.summary: Indian residents earning income abroad may need a Tax Residency Certificate to claim benefits under tax treaties. The Income Tax Department allows eligible taxpayers to apply online under the Income-tax Act, 2025. Here’s how Form 42 works, who can apply and what to know before filing.
